Politics · India

Political Leaders Discuss PM Candidacy and Election Strategies

Discussions and statements from various political figures have emerged regarding potential Prime Ministerial candidates and election strategies. While some leaders, like Tamil Congress leaders, have backed Rahul Gandhi for PM in 2029, others, such as the DMK, have pushed back against pitches for actor Vijay as a PM candidate, emphasizing support for Rahul Gandhi instead. Meanwhile, Maharashtra's SIR has been cited by Congress to vindicate Rahul Gandhi's 'vote chori' claim, and Uttarakhand CM Dhami has targeted Rahul Gandhi over caste remarks, urging against divisive politics. Additionally, a statement from Congress leader Supriya Shrinate attacked the stopping of Rahul Gandhi's Prayagraj program, suggesting it was due to fear of him.
